en.name: eNAM (National Agriculture Market)
en.description: Online trading platform integrating APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
en.eligibility: Farmers, traders, and FPOs registered with linked APMC mandis.
en.benefits: Better price discovery, transparent bidding, wider buyer reach, reduced intermediaries.
application_steps: Link APMC mandi and bank account.
Payment settled to farmer account post-trade.
faqs: How do I sell on eNAM?
What is the official website for this service?
